Empty State

Empty states guide users when a view has no data, offering context and a clear next action.

Basic Empty State

Icon, title, supporting text, and a prompt action button.

No projects yet

Create your first project to start organizing your work and collaborating with your team.

HTML
<div class="zak-empty-state">
    <span class="zak-empty-state-icon">
        <svg class="zak-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">...</svg>
    </span>
    <h3 class="zak-empty-state-title">No projects yet</h3>
    <p class="zak-empty-state-text">Create your first project to start organizing your work.</p>
    <div class="zak-empty-state-action">
        <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-primary">Create Project</button>
    </div>
</div>

Empty State with Illustration

Use an illustration block (gradient tile standing in for artwork) with copy and action.

Build your dashboard

Add widgets like charts and KPIs to see your data at a glance.

HTML
<div class="zak-empty-state">
    <!-- illustration -->
    <div style="width:7rem;height:7rem;border-radius:var(--zak-radius-lg);
         background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--zak-primary-100),var(--zak-info-100));
         display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--zak-color-primary);">
        <svg class="zak-icon" style="width:3rem;height:3rem;">...</svg>
    </div>
    <h3 class="zak-empty-state-title">Build your dashboard</h3>
    <p class="zak-empty-state-text">Add widgets like charts and KPIs.</p>
    <div class="zak-empty-state-action">
        <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-outline-primary">Add Widget</button>
    </div>
</div>

Empty State for Search (No Results)

Guide users when a search query returns nothing.

No results found

We couldn't find anything matching "quix". Try different keywords or check the spelling.

HTML
<div class="zak-empty-state">
    <span class="zak-empty-state-icon">
        <svg class="zak-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="8"/><path d="m21 21-4.35-4.35"/></svg>
    </span>
    <h3 class="zak-empty-state-title">No results found</h3>
    <p class="zak-empty-state-text">We couldn't find anything matching "quix".</p>
    <div class="zak-empty-state-action">
        <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-secondary">Clear Search</button>
    </div>
</div>

Empty State for Error

Help users recover from failed loads.

Something went wrong

We couldn't load this page. Please retry or check your connection.

HTML
<div class="zak-empty-state">
    <span class="zak-empty-state-icon" style="color:var(--zak-color-danger);">
        <svg class="zak-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2">...</svg>
    </span>
    <h3 class="zak-empty-state-title">Something went wrong</h3>
    <p class="zak-empty-state-text">We couldn't load this page.</p>
    <div class="zak-empty-state-action">
        <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-danger">Retry</button>
    </div>
</div>

A compact variant with just an icon and short copy.

No notifications

You're all caught up!

HTML
<div class="zak-empty-state">
    <span class="zak-empty-state-icon">...</svg></span>
    <h3 class="zak-empty-state-title">No notifications</h3>
    <p class="zak-empty-state-text">You're all caught up!</p>
</div>

CSS Classes & Variables

HTML
.zak-empty-state        /* Centered column container */
.zak-empty-state-icon    /* Circular icon wrapper */
.zak-empty-state-title   /* Bold title */
.zak-empty-state-text    /* Muted supporting text */
.zak-empty-state-action  /* Action area below copy */

Accessibility

  • Use a real heading element (<h2>/<h3>) for the empty-state title so it fits the document outline.
  • Icon-only decorations must have aria-hidden="true" or be inside an alt="" context.
  • Make the primary action a real button or link with a descriptive label.
  • If the empty state appears after an async load, announce it with aria-live="polite".
HTML
<div class="zak-empty-state" role="status" aria-live="polite">
    <span class="zak-empty-state-icon" aria-hidden="true">...</svg></span>
    <h3 class="zak-empty-state-title">No results</h3>
    <p class="zak-empty-state-text">Try adjusting your filters.</p>
    <div class="zak-empty-state-action">
        <button class="zak-btn zak-btn-primary">Clear Filters</button>
    </div>
</div>
